transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, doctor... I hope it's alright that I'm taking up your time. I want to be helpful and do the right thing by coming in. It's just... well, everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining things, and I really don't want to cause any trouble or sound unreasonable to you, but... I know my wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. 

I try to be a logical guy, you know? But my tools, they don’t just move themselves. And my fishing plans... they keep getting spoiled every single weekend, and it's not by accident. I hate to complain, I really do, but after all these months... I can see plain as day he’s been trying to take over my place and push me out. Does... does that make sense how I explained it? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t?

Oh, no, doctor. No, nothing like that. I... I know how some of what I said must sound, and I really don't want you to think I'm, well, losing my grip or anything. I promise I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. 

I just see regular things, you know? Like my wrenches being left on the wrong workbench, or my tackle box being messed with. Things anybody would see if they were standing right next to me and looking at it. I'm just a normal guy noticing what's right in front of him. I hope I'm answering your question right... I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to know. Did I explain that okay?
Do you believe, without any doubt, that your wife’s relative is actually trying to harm or drive you out?

I... well, I really hate to sound stubborn, doctor. I know you're just trying to figure this all out, and I want to be as cooperative as I possibly can. But... yes. Yes, I do believe it without a shadow of a doubt. 

I wouldn't bring it up and take up your time if I wasn't absolutely sure. Like I was saying before, about my tools getting messed with at my bench and my fishing trips getting ruined every single weekend... it's just too much to be a coincidence, you know? After all these months of it happening, it's just clear to me that he's trying to drive me out of my own home. 

I hope it's alright that I'm being so blunt about it... I just figure honesty is the best policy here, right? Am I giving you the kind of answers you need?
Have you noticed any problems with your thinking, like trouble keeping your thoughts organized or following along with what people are saying?

Oh, no, doctor... nothing like that at all. I like to think my mind is still as sharp as a tack. 

You know, working at the assembly plant all these years, you really have to stay focused and keep everything in order, or things just don't fit together right. I never have any trouble keeping up with conversations or following along with what the guys at work are saying. My thoughts are perfectly clear, I promise. 

I hope that answers your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and not leaving anything out that you might need. Did I explain that alright?
Do you think this person has done anything impossible or clearly unrealistic, like using supernatural powers or affecting your thoughts?

Oh, no, no. Nothing crazy like that, doctor. I... I know how important it is to be clear about this, and I really don't want you to think I believe in magic or anything silly. 

It's just normal, everyday stuff he's doing. Sneaking around, moving my things, messing with my tools... things any regular person could do if they were trying to be a nuisance. He can't read my mind or use powers or anything like that. I just want to assure you that my feet are firmly planted on the ground here. I'm just dealing with a very real, very frustrating person. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm not sounding defensive, I just want to make sure you know I'm thinking completely rationally about all this. Is that what you were asking?
Have you noticed any strange changes in your emotions or motivation lately?

No, not really... I mean, I feel like I'm doing pretty well in that department, doctor. I hope that's okay to say. 

I still get up and go to the plant every day, put in my hours, and do a good job. I still want to go fishing, even though... well, even though things keep happening to ruin it. But my motivation is still there! And my emotions... I mean, sure, I get frustrated about the situation at home, but who wouldn't, right? I'm not depressed or flying off the handle or anything like that. I try to stay pretty even-keeled. 

I just want to be a good husband and a good worker, you know? I hope I'm giving you the right picture of how things are... I'm doing my best to be completely open with you. Does that sound like a normal way to be feeling to you?
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were not your own or that someone could hear your thoughts?

Oh, goodness, no. No, doctor, nothing like that. I... I know that's something you probably have to ask everybody, but my thoughts are completely my own. Nobody else can hear them, and nobody is putting them in my head. 

I just want to be really clear about that, because I wouldn't want you to think I'm... well, you know, losing my grip on reality or anything. My mind is my own private business, just like anyone else's. 

I hope that's the right way to answer that? I really want to make sure I'm being helpful and giving you exactly what you need for your notes. Am I doing okay with these questions so far?
Has this belief caused any trouble at work, at home, or with other people?

Well... I mean, I wouldn't say it's caused *trouble*, exactly. I just... I have to be a bit more careful now, that's all. I hope that makes sense. 

Like, I don't leave my equipment out where I used to, and I spend a bit more time making sure the workshop is locked up tight and checking on things. Just being responsible, you know? And at home, I just try to stay out of his way. Avoid him when I can. It... well, it has made things a little tense with my wife, I guess. I hate admitting that, because I want everything to be peaceful at home. But I'm still going to work every day, still doing my job as an assembler, still taking care of what needs taking care of. 

I'm really trying my best not to let it affect the important things. I hope you can see that I'm handling it as responsibly as I can. Does that sound like I'm managing it okay? I really don't want this to seem like it's ruining my life or anything.
Have you ever had any hallucinations, like hearing voices when no one is there?

Oh, no, doctor. No, definitely not. I've never heard any voices or... or seen things that aren't there. I know that's something you have to check for, but I promise you, I don't have anything like that going on. 

I mean, sometimes my ears ring a little bit just from all the noise on the assembly line over the years, but that's just normal wear and tear, right? Definitely no people talking to me when I'm alone or anything spooky like that. 

I really want to assure you that my mind is perfectly sound in that way. I hope you believe me? I'm just trying to give you the exact truth so you can see I'm doing okay and holding it together. Does that help clear things up for your notes?
Have you been feeling sad or down most days lately?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say that. I mean, sure, everyone gets a little tired or... or has a quiet day now and then, especially with, well, just the stress of keeping an eye on things lately. But sad? No, I'm not a depressed person or anything like that. 

I still get up, go to work, do my job... I try to keep a positive attitude, really I do. I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around moping or letting things get me down. I'm handling everything as best as I can. 

Is that what you're looking for? I just want to make sure you know I'm staying strong and keeping my chin up, despite... well, everything. I hope that's a good sign?
Have you ever had a period of several days or longer when you felt unusually high, energetic, or needed much less sleep than usual?

Oh, no, definitely not. I've never had anything like that. I mean, I always try to get my full eight hours of sleep. I'm a steady guy, you know? 

I just go to work, do my shifts, come home... I don't get all wound up or bouncing off the walls. I like to keep things calm and predictable. I guess you could say I'm pretty boring that way! 

I hope that's the right answer? I just want to reassure you that I'm very stable. I don't have those kind of extreme ups and downs you hear about. Does that sound like what you'd expect from someone who's doing alright?
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast to other people?

Oh, gosh, no. No, my thoughts are... they're completely my own. I definitely don't feel like anyone can hear what's in my head, or... or that they're being broadcast out loud or anything like that. 

I keep my thoughts very private. I just, you know, focus on my work at the plant and mind my own business. I know you have to ask these kinds of questions to make sure I'm doing okay, but I promise my mind is totally secure in that way. No one else can hear what I'm thinking. 

I'm really just a regular, private guy. I hope that shows you I'm thinking clearly? I'm really trying to be as helpful and honest as I can with you so you know I'm doing alright.
Do you think this relative is a real person who could actually be in your home, or do you believe he is someone impossible, like an impostor or supernatural being?

Oh, no, no, definitely a real person. Just... just my actual relative. I wouldn't ever think it was something supernatural or... or an impostor or anything like that. I know that sounds like something out of a movie, and I'm really not into any of that kind of stuff. 

I'm just a practical guy, you know? I work with my hands, I put parts together at the shop... I deal with real, physical things. So, no, I know it's really him. It's just a normal, flesh-and-blood person. 

I hope that makes sense? I really want you to see that I have both feet on the ground here. I'm not imagining ghosts or anything impossible, I promise. Does that help clear things up for you? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.
How long have you been convinced that your wife’s relative is trying to drive you out of your home?

Well, it's... it's been about nine months now. It started right around the time he moved in with us. 

I mean, I know how that sounds—like I'm just complaining about an in-law overstaying their welcome, right? I really try to be a good host, I do. I want my wife to be happy, and I want to be the kind of husband who supports his family. I'm not trying to be difficult or make a fuss out of nothing. 

But it's just... since he got here, nine months ago, it's become so clear what he's trying to do. I'm just trying to protect my home, you know? I hope you can understand that. It's normal to want to feel secure in your own house, right? I'm just trying to handle it the best way a reasonable guy can. Does that seem like a normal reaction to you?
Has anyone else ever told you that they think your beliefs about your relative are unusual or not based in reality?

Well, um... yes, my wife, mostly. She... she gets a little upset when I bring it up. She tells me I'm just being paranoid or that I'm imagining things. And I guess some of her family thinks I'm just being a grumpy old guy who doesn't like having company. 

I really don't want to cause any trouble, you know? I hate arguing with her. I want to be a good husband, I really do. But... but I'm not imagining it. I know I'm not. It's just... my tools out in the garage, they don't move themselves, right? And every single weekend, my fishing plans just happen to get spoiled by some accident or another. It's too much of a coincidence. 

I know it probably sounds silly to other people, and I really wish I didn't have to bring it up, but after all these months... it's just plain as day to me that he's trying to take over my place and push me out. I'm just trying to hold onto my home. I hope you don't think I'm crazy for feeling that way? It's just hard when everyone else acts like I'm making it all up, but I promise you, I'm just looking at the facts. Do you... do you think it's understandable why I'd be upset about my things being messed with?
Have you ever felt that people are trying to read your mind?

Oh, no, definitely not. No one's reading my mind. I know that sounds like... well, like something you'd see in a science fiction movie or something, and I'm really not into any of that. 

I'm just a regular guy, you know? I go to work, I come home... my thoughts are just my own. I wouldn't ever think something so... out there. I hope that makes sense? I really want to make sure you know I'm completely grounded in reality here. I'm just dealing with a difficult situation at home, that's all. Does that sound like a reasonable answer to you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever heard voices or other sounds that seemed to come from nowhere when no one else was present?

No, no, nothing like that. I've never heard any voices or sounds like that. I know some people struggle with those kinds of things, and I have a lot of sympathy for them, but... well, my hearing is perfectly fine, and I only hear what's actually there. 

I'm really just a normal, quiet guy trying to keep his life together. I wouldn't want you to think I'm... you know, losing my grip or anything. I'm just dealing with this situation with my brother-in-law, and that's really the only thing that's been bothering me. I hope I'm being helpful by answering these questions for you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to understand where I'm coming from.
Have you ever had trouble organizing your thoughts or speaking in a way that others find hard to follow?

No, I... I don't think so. I mean, my wife sometimes says I get a little worked up when I'm explaining what's happening with her brother, but I think anyone would, right? 

But as far as my thoughts being jumbled or... or not making sense? No, I'm pretty clear on everything. I always try to speak plainly. I know I'm just a guy who works on an assembly line, I don't have a big fancy vocabulary or anything, but people understand me just fine. 

I really try my best to be clear, especially with you. I want to make sure I'm explaining things the right way. Am I making sense to you now? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm confused or... or rambling. I really value your opinion, and I want to be a good patient for you.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or experiences, besides this one about your relative?

No, no, nothing else. I promise. I don't have any strange ideas or... or anything like that. It's really just this one thing with my brother-in-law. 

I know how it might look, me coming in here and talking about all this, and I really don't want you to think I'm the kind of person who believes in crazy things. I'm just a normal guy, you know? I go to work, I pay my bills... I just want my family to be okay. 

I don't have any other... well, unusual experiences, like you said. Just the facts about what's going on at home. Does that sound alright? I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time with all this. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of everything.
Have you ever had any other fixed beliefs that other people thought were very unusual or impossible?

Oh, um, no, Doctor. I really don't. I know you have to be thorough and ask all these things to do your job, but... no. Nothing impossible or... or weird like that. 

I'm a pretty grounded person, honestly. Outside of this whole mess with my brother-in-law, my life is just... well, it's just putting in my hours at the plant and coming home. I don't get caught up in wild theories or anything. 

I hope it's okay that my answer is no again? I swear I'm not trying to be difficult or hide anything from you, I just want to be completely honest. Am I doing alright with these questions? I really just want to make sure I'm doing this right and giving you the information you need.
